title: Context-Aware Mobile Intervention for Social Recovery in Serious Mental Illness (R33)
official: Context-Aware Mobile Intervention for Social Recovery in Serious Mental Illness (R33)
summary: This randomized clinical trial will test a new technology-supported blended intervention, mobile Social Interaction Therapy by Exposure (mSITE), that targets social engagement in consumers with serious mental illness.

interventions.name: Mobile Intervention for Social Recovery in Serious Mental Illness (mSITE)
